Apple (AAPL) vs Microsoft (MSFT): on the same formula, their operating margins are 13.8 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AAPL: $478.8B · MSFT: $331.8B
• Revenue growth — AAPL: +15.1% · MSFT: +17.8%
• Operating margin — AAPL: 33.0% · MSFT: 46.8%
• Net margin — AAPL: 27.6% · MSFT: 40.3%
• Free cash flow margin — AAPL: 28.4% · MSFT: 20.2%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AAPL: 5.0% · MSFT: 13.7%

Different fiscal years: AAPL Sep 26, 2026 · MSFT Jun 30, 2026. The periods are not identical.
